# AI Resume Tailor

> AI Resume Tailor is a web app that tailors your existing resume to a specific job description and includes a free ATS resume checker. Your first 3 tailored resumes are free; further access is a one-time purchase with no subscription.

AI Resume Tailor focuses on one task: rewriting your existing resume so it matches the wording of a specific job posting, with ATS-friendly formatting and human-sounding output. You paste your resume and the job description and get a tailored version. The site also provides a free ATS resume checker that reports compatibility, formatting, and missing-keyword signals. There is no auto-renewing subscription — paid access is a one-time purchase for a fixed period.

## Core pages
- [Free ATS Resume Checker](https://airesumetailor.com/resume-checker): ATS compatibility score, layout and header checks, missing-keyword detection, and action-verb strength.
- [Resume Optimizer](https://airesumetailor.com/resume-optimizer): Tailors your resume to a job description with keyword matching and human-sounding output.
- [Pricing](https://airesumetailor.com/pricing): One-time access tiers (2-day, 1-week, 1-month). The first 3 tailored resumes are free; no subscription.
- [FAQ](https://airesumetailor.com/faq): Common questions about resume tailoring, ATS scoring, and pricing.
- [Blog](https://airesumetailor.com/blog): Guides on resume tailoring, ATS compatibility, and role-specific keywords.
